_comment: Models Salik serves through POST /v1/chat/completions and lists at GET /v1/models. `provider` is which backend owns `upstreamModel` (ollama | anthropic | openai) — ollama/openai need no translation (both already speak OpenAI's chat completions dialect), anthropic goes through src/providers/anthropic/. `fallback` is this model's own one-hop fallback; anything that omits it uses `defaultFallback` instead. Run `bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test` after editing — src/config.ts's parseModelRegistry validates this at startup and refuses to start on a dangling/self-referential fallback. It validates EVERY entry of "models", so a `// note` object cannot be parked in that array the way one can be here. gpt-5-mini (trip-agent's model) names gpt-5-nano as its fallback rather than taking the server-wide default ON PURPOSE: trip-agent asks for Structured Outputs (response_format.json_schema) and forced tool calls, and src/providers/anthropic/request.ts rejects response_format outright — a hop to an Anthropic-backed model would turn every one of its document extractions into an error, so its fallback stays in the same dialect. gpt-5.4-mini (Donna's model) names gpt-5-mini for a stricter reason: Donna sends personal screen text that may only ever reach OpenAI, so a failed call must never hop to the Anthropic-backed default.
